replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
Sorry, but this is really bad. The lanes are thin, the ground is ugly, it's boring and there's not one little speck of height variation in the ground. You also have no path to get to the other monument in one life, because players spawn right between them (there's nothing to buy time like Rendezvous.)

I don't really comment on submissions too much, but I expected better, especially to represent the contest and the fact that you just released Dunebreak already which is very similar in layout excluding the front lines of the sides (or rather what I'd assume to be a middle ground.)

I don't see any replay value and when pitted against other DTM maps, I don't think this would be something that'd stay in rotations. When building, go for quality and draft some good gameplay designs and ideas so it isn't just a "one add and then remove" map for a rotation update, make it something that is worth remembering and fun.
